prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): none
Changes already tested and stopped: none
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Preview & Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet pick screen into a stage layout with dynamic animated pet previews so users test interactions before choosing.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s), plus 3 support emails reported custom pet visual issues.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Preview companion animations and desktop interactions before adopting.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-in After Adoption
candidates.change: Move sign-in after the adoption certificate so users choose and customize their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users upfront and 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in now to backup your companion so it is never lost or reset.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet syncs across device restarts.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated interactive guide screen before desktop entry that details how to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Waiting median time is 201s and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets post-setup.

new_desktop_guide.headline: Master Desktop Controls
new_desktop_guide.body: Quickly learn how to summon, move, talk to, and hide your pet on your desktop.

components.text: Click to talk; Drag to position; Right-click taskbar icon to hide

candidates.title: Guided Path Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive quick-quiz screen before path selection to help users choose between standard and custom pets.
candidates.why: Path selection takes a mean time of 514s and loses 23.8% of initial users.

new_path_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Pet Type
new_path_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions to find out which pet creation path fits your setup best.

components.text: Instant Pet vs Custom Photo Pet

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path
choose_path.body: Select standard preset companion or upload photos for a custom companion.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance
candidates.change: Add photo lighting and angle guidance hints on the upload screen to improve pet rendering quality.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.

upload_photos.hint: Upload well-lit front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet rendering.

candidates.title: Real-time Waiting Progress & Taskbar Tips
candidates.change: Display explicit rendering progress and system tray tips on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 users reported pet not appearing on desktop.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet for Desktop...
waiting.body: Your pet model is rendering. Make sure your desktop taskbar permits overlay apps.

components.text: Tip: If pet disappears, click the tray icon to bring it back.

candidates.title: Account Protection & Reset Prevention Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explain that account login preserves pets and avoids accidental pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Log in to bind your pet to your account cloud backup so your pet never resets.
sign_in.hint: Use your primary email to ensure seamless pet recovery.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Onboarding Stage
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout with short video demos and interactive test buttons for pet shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long completion times, and users struggle with post-onboarding controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Try the interactive shortcuts below to get comfortable managing your pet.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Badge & Card Layout
candidates.change: Transform adoption_certificate into a card layout with a official adoption badge and desktop spawn button.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Completed
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion certificate is ready. Click below to spawn your pet on desktop.

candidates.title: Story Screen Welcome Mascot
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot guide and starter item incentive callout to the opening story screen.
candidates.why: First step choose_path has a high mean time of 514s; engaging users early improves completion.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets!
story.body: Adopt your desktop companion today and unlock free starter accessories!
